description: DB + contract foundation: the six new tenant-owned Prisma models + four enums, the ONE hand-authored migration (phase6 house style a-j, incl. RLS, composite/partial FKs, the two append-only trigger families, the campass_app GRANT refresh, and the fees.* + ACCOUNTANT catalogue seed), and the packages/shared catalogue changes (fees.* permission keys + ROLE_PERMISSIONS bindings, fees.* audit keys, MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees = [], and the Zod validation incl. the single PaiseAmount money schema). Everything else depends on this. Grounded in design.md §C/§D.1/§D.2/§D.3/§D.4/§D.12/§D.13/§D.15/§D.16 and review NITs 1 & 3 (the targetChargeIds non-FK note and the 23505-only dedup rule are documented here; their tests live in FEAT-004). Leaves the repo buildable: schema generates, migration deploys clean, shared type-checks, and catalogue-sync reaches set-equality once FEAT-002 adds the dir to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS (note in findings).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/phase7-fees-slice1/context.json and design.md §D.1/§D.2/§D.3 FIRST. Add to packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma the four enums (FeeStructureStatus{DRAFT,ACTIVE,ARCHIVED}, FeeComponentCategory{TUITION,LIBRARY,LAB,EXAM,OTHER}, StudentChargeStatus{PENDING,PARTIALLY_PAID,PAID}, PaymentTransactionStatus{CREATED,AUTHORIZED,CAPTURED,FAILED}) and the six models FeeStructure, FeeComponent, StudentCharge, PaymentTransaction, PaymentAllocation, Receipt, ProcessedWebhookEvent (that is 7 models total per §D.2 — fee_structures, fee_components, student_charges, payment_transactions, payment_allocations, receipts, processed_webhook_events). Single-PK relations only; money columns are BigInt; currency String @default("INR"); payment_transactions.targetChargeIds String[]; receipts.sequence Int. Add institution relations, @@unique([id, institutionId]) and @@index([institutionId]) per table, and the business uniques/indexes from §D.2 expressible in Prisma. Do NOT attempt composite FKs / partial uniques / RLS / triggers in Prisma — those are raw SQL in the migration.
Run `npm run db:generate` (prisma generate) and confirm the client compiles.

Hand-author packages/db/prisma/migrations/<newts>_phase7_fees_slice1/migration.sql mirroring 20261115000000_phase6_admissions/migration.sql section-for-section (a enums; b tables+PKs with createdAt DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updatedAt NOT NULL on the mutable tables; c (id,institutionId) uniques + business uniques + (institutionId)/query indexes + the raw-SQL partial unique payment_transactions_payment_id_unique ON (institutionId, razorpayPaymentId) WHERE razorpayPaymentId IS NOT NULL + the global unique on processed_webhook_events(razorpayEventId) + its (institutionId,razorpayEventId) composite + receipts (institutionId,sequence)/(institutionId,receiptNumber)/(institutionId,paymentTransactionId) uniques; d tenant-root institutionId->institutions(id) RESTRICT on all 7; e composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId per §D.2 — student_charges->student_profiles/fee_structures/fee_components, fee_components->fee_structures, fee_structures->programs/academic_sessions, payment_transactions->student_profiles, payment_allocations->payment_transactions/student_charges, receipts->payment_transactions, processed_webhook_events->payment_transactions (nullable); f CHECKs amountPaise>0, currency='INR', char_length(name|description)>=1, sequence>0; g RLS ENABLE+FORCE: standard select+modify pair on fee_structures/fee_components/student_charges/payment_transactions, and SELECT + <table>_tenant_insert INSERT-only pair on payment_allocations/receipts/processed_webhook_events, all nullif-guarded; h append-only triggers: unconditional-raise <table>_append_only() + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger x3 on the INSERT-only tables (mirror application_reviews), plus the TWO new column-guard functions payment_transactions_guard() and student_charges_guard() copied VERBATIM from §D.3 with their BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers; i guarded DO $$ IF EXISTS pg_roles ... 'campass_app' GRANT refresh: full DML on fee_structures/fee_components/student_charges/payment_transactions, SELECT,INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE on the 3 append-only tables; j catalogue seed: INSERT INTO "roles" the ACCOUNTANT row (id 'role_accountant', key 'ACCOUNTANT', institutionId NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING BEFORE the permissions block; INSERT INTO "permissions" the 7 fees.* rows ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO "role_permissions" ... VALUES (...) AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN ... the tuples ACCOUNTANT x{fees.structures.manage,fees.charges.manage,fees.view,fees.collect}, ADMIN x the same four, STUDENT x fees.view_own — fees.refund/fees.adjust bound to NO role). The header comment must list the 12 FROZEN dirs and state it CREATEs only, never ALTERs a frozen table or the _prisma_migrations ledger, and never grants BYPASSRLS.

Verify the migration with the read-only diff (NEVER migrate dev): `prisma migrate diff` from the schema datasource to the schema datamodel as a --script, confirm it shows ONLY the new objects and NO change to the 12 frozen dirs/ledger. Then `prisma migrate deploy`, then `prisma migrate status` must report up to date. Retry transient P1001/'tenant or user not found' after ~10-15s (Supabase auto-pause).

Edit packages/shared/src/permissions.ts: append 7 fees.* PermissionDef entries (module 'fees'): fees.structures.manage, fees.charges.manage, fees.view, fees.collect, fees.view_own, fees.refund, fees.adjust. In ROLE_PERMISSIONS add a new ACCOUNTANT key = [fees.structures.manage, fees.charges.manage, fees.view, fees.collect]; add the same four to ADMIN; add fees.view_own to STUDENT. Do NOT bind fees.refund/fees.adjust to any role (forward-declared, §D.12).

Edit packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts: append the 16 fees.* AuditActionDef entries from §D.13 (fees.structure.created, fees.structure.updated, fees.component.added, fees.charge.posted, fees.charges.bulk_posted, fees.payment.order_created, fees.payment.signature_verified, fees.payment.signature_rejected, fees.payment.captured, fees.payment.failed, fees.payment.reconciled, fees.receipt.issued, fees.webhook.received, fees.webhook.duplicate_ignored, fees.webhook.signature_rejected, fees.webhook.skipped_module_inactive). No migration mirror (validated in recordAuditEvent).

Edit packages/shared/src/modules.ts: change MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees from ["student_management"] to [] with a comment mirroring the attendance/admissions foundational-not-gated rationale (its real prerequisite is foundational StudentProfile data with no ACTIVE InstitutionModule row).

Edit packages/shared/src/validation.ts: add the single PaiseAmount schema VERBATIM from §D.1 (z.string().regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/).transform(BigInt).refine(v => v > 0n && v <= BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER))) and the fees request schemas used by FEAT-002: create/patch fee-structure, add fee-component (amount via PaiseAmount), post-charge (single) + bulk-charge, Stage-1 payment body { chargeIds: string[] nonempty }, Stage-2 verify body { razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature }, reconciliation inputs. No money field may be a z.number().
Type-check the shared package (npx tsc) and run `npm run db:generate` again if schema touched.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run db:generate` succeeds and the Prisma client exposes the 7 new models + 4 enums.

The read-only `prisma migrate diff` shows ONLY the new fees tables/enums/indexes/constraints and NO change to any of the 12 frozen dirs or the _prisma_migrations ledger; after `prisma migrate deploy`, `prisma migrate status` reports up to date.

Every new tenant-owned table has institutionId, (id, institutionId) composite unique, (institutionId) index, composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId, and ENABLE+FORCE RLS with the nullif-guarded fail-closed policies; amountPaise columns are BIGINT; currency is a stored non-null 'INR' with a CHECK.

packages/shared type-checks (npx tsc clean) with the 7 fees.* permission keys, the ACCOUNTANT ROLE_PERMISSIONS binding, the 16 fees.* audit keys, MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees === [], and the PaiseAmount + fees Zod schemas present.
The migration seed block is parseable by catalogue-sync.test.ts's slicers (roles row before the permissions block; role_permissions tuples between 'INSERT INTO "role_permissions"' and 'AS m(').
verification: prisma migrate diff (read-only --script) then prisma migrate deploy then prisma migrate status (from packages/db) — expect 'up to date', 12 frozen dirs untouched

npm test -w @campusgate/api -- catalogue-sync (will reach set-equality only after FEAT-002 adds the dir to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS — see findings; the fees.* keys + ACCOUNTANT pairs must already be present in both shared and the migration seed so the union matches then)
findings:

f CHECKs amountPaise>0, currency='INR', char_length(name|description)>=1, sequence>0; g RLS ENABLE+FORCE — standard select+modify pair on fee_structures/fee_components/student_charges/payment_transactions, SELECT + <table>_tenant_insert INSERT-only pair on payment_allocations/receipts/processed_webhook_events, all nullif-guarded fail-closed; h append-only triggers — unconditional-raise <table>_append_only() + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE x3 on the INSERT-only tables, plus the TWO column-guard functions payment_transactions_guard() and student_charges_guard() copied VERBATIM from §D.3 with BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers; i guarded DO $$ IF EXISTS pg_roles 'campass_app' GRANT refresh — full DML on the 4 mutable/snapshot tables, SELECT,INSERT + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE on the 3 append-only tables (never BYPASSRLS); j catalogue seed — INSERT INTO roles the ACCOUNTANT row (id 'role_accountant', key 'ACCOUNTANT', institutionId NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING BEFORE the permissions block; INSERT INTO permissions the 7 fees.* rows ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO role_permissions ... AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN the tuples ACCOUNTANT x{structures.manage,charges.manage,view,collect}, ADMIN x the same four, STUDENT x fees.view_own; fees.refund/fees.adjust bound to NO role.

SHARED: permissions.ts — 7 fees.* PermissionDef entries (module 'fees') + ACCOUNTANT ROLE_PERMISSIONS key (the four staff keys) + the same four appended to ADMIN + fees.view_own appended to STUDENT; refund/adjust unbound. audit-actions.ts — the 16 fees.* AuditActionDef entries from §D.13. modules.ts — MODULE_DEPENDENCIES.fees changed from ["student_management"] to [] with the foundational-not-gated rationale comment. validation.ts — the single PaiseAmount schema VERBATIM from §D.1 + fees request schemas (create/patch fee-structure, add fee-component via PaiseAmount, post-charge single + bulk-charge, Stage-1 createPayment { chargeIds: nonempty string[] }, Stage-2 verifyPayment { razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature }, reconciliation query + run inputs); no money field is a z.number().

VERIFICATION: `npm run db:generate` succeeds (Prisma client exposes the 7 models + 4 enums). Read-only `prisma migrate diff` from datasource to datamodel shows ONLY the new fees enums/tables/indexes/constraints created plus the long-standing composite-vs-single same-tenant-FK cosmetic diff that EVERY prior phase (admissions/library/academics) also shows (Prisma cannot model composite FKs; verified the admissions *_same_tenant_fkey rows produce the identical DROP-composite/ADD-single pattern) — NO DROP touches any of the 7 new tables and NOTHING touches the 12 frozen dirs or _prisma_migrations ledger. `prisma migrate deploy` applied only 20261122000000_phase7_fees_slice1; `prisma migrate status` reports 'Database schema is up to date!'
